hook_lines: Found this at Don Quijote in Japan
Their first premium jelly in 15 years

chalkboard.title: What People Are Saying
bullets: This brand's collagen jelly has sold since 2011 — the premium line only launched in October 2025
Beauty ingredients jumped from 7 to 10, with new glucosylceramide added
One box (15 sticks) packs 37,500mg of fish collagen, plus a new 20% golden pineapple juice blend
Pre-launch survey (n=100) found effect, price, and taste mattered most to buyers
The sister product released alongside it isn't collagen — it's placenta jelly (grape flavor), easy to mix up on the shelf
usage_steps: Just squeeze one stick straight from the pack, once a day

usage_placeholder.description: 실제로 콜라겐씨젤리 프리미엄리치(골든파인애플 맛)를 뜯어서 짜 먹는 리액션 영상. 스틱을 반으로 접어 짜는 손짓, 한 입 먹고 파인애플 맛에 반응하는 표정 위주 클로즈업. 10~15초 분량이면 충분.
usage_placeholder.xiaohongshu_query: 日本 胶原蛋白果冻条 试吃

quotes.japanese: ややすっぱめのベリー系の味なので続けられそうです！1本あたり12kcalなのも嬉しい！
quotes.translation: It's a slightly tart berry flavor, so I feel like I can keep taking it. Only 12 kcal per stick is a nice bonus too!

quotes.japanese: アサイーベリー味が甘酸っぱくて美味しいです。ゼリーはそのまま食べられるので毎日続けられます
quotes.translation: The acai berry flavor is sweet and tangy, and it tastes great. The jelly's ready to eat straight out of the pack, so it's easy to keep up daily.

quotes.japanese: もっちりしたしっかりめの食感で、味も食感も個人的には好きなほうです
quotes.translation: It has a chewy, substantial texture — honestly, I like both the taste and the texture.

quotes.japanese: コラーゲンというかゼラチンの味が主張強めなのが苦手ポイント1で、人工甘味料の味が舌に残るのが苦手ポイント2
quotes.translation: The gelatin taste comes through stronger than the collagen itself, which is one thing I don't love, and the artificial sweetener lingers on my tongue afterward — that's the other.
